_about: Frozen extractor design for the HTN guideline, version 2 (addendum HTN v2, sections 5 and 15). Changes from v1 follow the blind review of addendum v1 (issues 1-3), the coordinator's decisions and the student's decision of 12/11/2026 that the two extractors come from different model families, all made before any HTN extraction output existed: run and retry policy, gate on the 70 audit-relevant Concept pairs, inter-model agreement, same-prompt test-retest, explicit verbatim-quotation requirement, extractor B = Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct AWQ on a rented GPU. v1 stays hashed.

vocabulary.note: The 12-Concept vocabulary is unchanged. HTN-specific item map: concepts_constructs_htn_v1.json.

extractor_A.name: Claude (prompt v1)
extractor_A.runtime: agent sub-sessions, one fresh sub-session per chunk, given only the system prompt and the rendered user message; temperature and max_tokens not controllable (as CKD deviation D2)

extractor_B.name: Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct (prompt v2, written independently of v1 for CKD event E1)

request.messages: system prompt v2 + rendered user message

runtime.length_guard: a rendered prompt above 16384 - 4096 tokens stops the run

weights.check: file hashes from the Hugging Face listing at the revision, verified after download

extractor_B.where: one rented Vast.ai GPU, see addendum section 15 and gpu_run below

session_rule: Extractor A: each chunk is given to a fresh sub-session that sees only its system prompt and rendered user message. Extractor B: each request carries only its system prompt and rendered user message, sent one at a time. Neither has access to the other extractor's prompt or output, the prereg, this addendum, the CKD outputs, the role tables or any results. File contents are passed verbatim.

parsing_rule: as extraction_settings_v1.json (first JSON object parsed; unparseable output = zero edges for that chunk, reported; out-of-vocabulary ids, u == v and not-recorded targets dropped and counted)
merge_rule: as extraction_settings_v1.json; agreed edge strength = weaker of the two (CKD clarification C8)
quotation_check: as prereg v3 4.4 and CKD clarification C5, on the frozen -raw and -layout conversions of the HTN PDF

recall_gate.when: before any HTN chunk is given to either extractor
recall_gate.chunks: the 18 frozen recall-gate chunks of the CKD A0 freeze, hash-checked
recall_gate.rendering: extractor A: the frozen rendered v1 user messages of the CKD A0 freeze (a0_freeze/prompts/gate_*_user.txt, hash-checked); extractor B: v2 user template filled by a0_render_gate_prompts_v2.py into outputs/q1_domain_htn/a0_freeze/prompts_gate_v2/
recall_gate.scoring: as prereg v3 4.4 and CKD clarification C3 (a1_ingest_kaggle_zip.py gate scoring, BRFSS item map)
recall_gate.pass_rule: each extractor separately: recovers the HEARTS-D agreed edge and at least 3 of the 5 MoH 5481 agreed edges after the quotation check; NG28 output reported as a false-positive count
recall_gate.if_one_fails: No fallback: no new prompt, model, quantisation or runtime is tried after a gate result. The HTN agreed graph, H3-HTN and A-Q4-HTN are 'not reached'; the passing extractor's quotation-checked edges are reported descriptively as a single-extractor graph. H1-HTN and H2-HTN run unchanged.

agreement_gate.unit: primary: the 70 audit-relevant Concept pairs (u, v), u != v, u in the 7 lever/treatable Concepts other than BLOOD_PRESSURE, v in the 11 Concepts other than BLOOD_PRESSURE (7 x 11 - 7 = 70); present for an extractor if at least one passage passes the quotation check. Secondary: all 88 pairs (CKD clarification C7), reported, not gated
agreement_gate.statistics: Cohen kappa, PABAK, positive and negative agreement (as CKD)
agreement_gate.pass_rule: Cohen kappa >= 0.40 and positive agreement >= 0.50 over the 70 audit-relevant pairs
agreement_gate.empty_case: If neither extractor finds any pair, kappa is undefined; the graph is empty and H3-HTN is 'not testable: degenerate graph' (not an agreement failure)
agreement_gate.if_fails: The intersection graph is still built and reported, but H3-HTN is reported as 'not testable: agreement gate failed'; A-Q4-HTN is reported descriptively only
agreement_gate.basis: 0.40 is the lower bound of 'moderate' agreement in the Landis-Koch convention; positive agreement guards against kappa being dominated by the many pairs neither extractor finds. Both are conventions, stated as such.
agreement_gate.name: inter-model agreement gate
agreement_gate.meaning: The extractors are two model families (Claude; Qwen2.5-72B) with two independently written prompts; agreement mixes model and prompt and the two cannot be separated. Both are LLMs, so errors shared by LLMs are not excluded. Passing the gate does not establish that the extraction is valid.

graph: intersection of the two extractors' Concept pairs; an agreed edge must carry, for EACH extractor, at least one verbatim quotation that passes the scripted quotation check against the frozen -raw/-layout text of the JACC PDF; union reported as secondary; no person adjudicates

run_policy.runs: exactly one run per chunk and per extractor (recall-gate chunks and HTN chunks alike); the first completed run is the run used
run_policy.retry: at most one retry, and only for a technical failure: an empty response, a timeout, or a tool or session error that returns no model text
run_policy.not_retried: an output that is returned but cannot be parsed counts as zero edges for that chunk (parsing_rule) and is never retried
run_policy.logging: every attempt, including failed ones, is saved with its time, the reason for any retry, and its SHA-256, in the extractor's output folder
run_policy.deviation: any other re-run of a chunk or of a whole gate or extraction pass is a deviation

test_retest.what: same-prompt test-retest, to separate run-to-run (stochastic) disagreement from disagreement between prompts
test_retest.sample: ceil(10% of the HTN chunks), at least 1, drawn once by numpy.random.default_rng(20261111).choice over chunk_index.csv rows in file order, without replacement, before any extraction; the drawn ids are written to test_retest_chunks.json and hashed
test_retest.runs: each sampled chunk is run a second time by each extractor (A: fresh sub-session; B: second request on the same server after all first runs); the second run is used only for this statistic, never for the graph
test_retest.statistics: per extractor, raw agreement and the counts both/only-run-1/only-run-2 over the 70 audit-relevant Concept pairs on the sampled chunks (after the quotation check); also between models on the same chunks

external_check: No human audit of edges (project rule: no human raters). The check outside the two extractors is the scripted word-for-word quotation check against the PDF text. The descriptive local third extractor is dropped.

gpu_run.provider: Vast.ai via the vastai CLI and the existing SSH key; the API key is never read

offer_rule.choice: cheapest matching offer at rent time

gpu_run.data_policy: only rendered chunk messages and the two system prompts are sent, never the PDF; deleted on the instance before destroy
close_down: verify SHA-256 against hashes computed on the instance
delete messages and prompts on the instance
vastai show instances must be empty
log rental id, offer, times, cost
